assumptions.aggregation: File totals include duplicate captures. Waterfall sums per-tape allocations; it does not re-round aggregate PnL.
assumptions.lookahead: Selection and expiry use full-capture metadata. Quotes do not use future trade prices. This is not a certified pre-trade strategy.
assumptions.pricing: Fixed 1-cent bid / 99-cent ask; no book inferred from prints.
assumptions.selection: Primary contract by normalized trade count; ID breaks ties.
assumptions.settlement: Assumed winning payout; not an official venue resolution.
assumptions.time_bounds: Observation/decision precede first selected print by 2s/1s; expiry is 300s after the last selected print.
